error.inviteRequired: This instance requires an invite. Please ask your admin for an invite link.
error.state: Your sign-in request expired. Please try again.

signup.inviteBanner: You're joining a family — this takes under a minute.
signup.joinFailed: Couldn't join the family. Please reopen the invite link and try again.
signup.autoUsernameFailed: Couldn't auto-generate a username. Please enter one yourself.

closed.title: You can only join by invite
closed.body: This family instance is already set up. Ask a family member for an invite link to sign up.

username.title: Pick a username
username.body: The username you'll sign in with (you can use it instead of an email). Lowercase letters, numbers, and ._- , 3–30 characters.

password.title: Create a password
password.body: At least 8 characters, and one you don't use elsewhere.

name.title: What should we call you?
name.titleInvited: What name should your family see?
name.body: This is the name your family will see.

email.title: Add an email?
email.body: Optional. If you add one, you can also sign in with your email.

optional.title: (Optional) Username or email
optional.body: Leave this blank and we'll create a temporary username for you.
optional.usernameError: Username must be 3–30 lowercase letters, numbers, or ._-

hero.tagline1: Photos, videos, growth, milestones, and stories — all in one place.
hero.tagline2: Kept safe in their original quality, shared with family in real time.

join.footnote: Accept to share in {family}'s photos and memories.

accept.error: Couldn't accept the invite. Please try again in a moment.

app.installHint: No app? We'll point you to the install page.

oidc.nameHint: Leave blank to join with your social account name.

invalid.title: This invite link is invalid
invalid.message: The link looks broken or mis-copied. Ask the sender to share it again.

used.title: This invite was already used
used.message: This link works only once. Try logging in with the account that already joined.

expired.title: This invite has expired
expired.message: It's past its valid period or was revoked. Get a new link and try again.
